file_roles.evidence: For FOR PORTION deletes, table->use_all_columns() skipped the marking that initialises rpl_write_set; the fix adds table->rpl_write_set= table->write_set, so pack_row no longer gets cols=0x0.

rationale: rpl_write_set was never set on the period-delete path, and the NULL bitmap crashed in pack_row during binlogging. The commit message says exactly this.
